Workers.Description: The centre's cleaning workers: their registration forms, documents and state.

Gate.NameTitle: Someone with this name is suspended or penalised
Gate.NameDescription: Only the name matches. Is this the same person?
Gate.AnswerTitle: Do we allow this person or not?
Gate.AnswerDescription: This person is suspended or penalised. The manager's answer and its reason are kept in the log.
Gate.ReasonRequired: Write the reason for the decision.
Gate.RequestDescription: This person is suspended or penalised. Send the question to the manager: what you typed is kept, and you come back to it once he answers.
Gate.RequestSent: The question was sent to the manager. Find it under «Suspended and penalised».

Card.Title: Suspended or penalised
Card.SetDescription: From the first day, the program stops this person being registered again without the manager's answer.
Card.LiftDescription: It ends today, whatever its end date.

Page.Title: Suspended and penalised
Page.DecisionsTitle: Do we allow them or not?
Page.DecisionsForManager: Every question asked when someone suspended or penalised was being registered. Yours to answer.
Page.DecisionsForClerk: The questions you sent to the manager, and his answers.
Page.AnswerDescription: {name} is being registered. The answer and its reason are kept in the log.

Form.PayDescription: Needed before the first pay run.

File.Title: Employee's file
File.AccountDescription: The account this employee signs in with. Accounts are made and linked in Settings.

Employees.Description: The centre's employees and their files.

Hours.None: No worker has hours this month.
Hours.NoHours: This worker has no hours this month.

Stats.OvertimeHint: Past 40 hours in a week, Saturday to Friday
Stats.LateHint: As typed from the mission orders

Weeks.Title: Weeks
Weeks.Hint: A week runs from Saturday to Friday and is counted whole in the month it ends in.
Weeks.None: No week ends in this month yet.

Corrections.Title: Corrections
Corrections.Hint: Hours that no mission order carries: a training day, work at the centre, a mistake put right.
Corrections.AddDescription: The correction is added to the day's hours and paid with them.
Corrections.Failed: The correction could not be saved.

Absences.Title: Absences and leave
Absences.Hint: Recorded on the attendance and absence tab; paid ones are paid as worked.

Runs.None: No pay run yet. Choose the month, then prepare it.
Runs.Hint: A month is prepared as a draft from the hours typed in, corrected, then closed. A closed month no longer changes: an order typed in afterwards is paid with the next month.
Runs.PrepareFailed: The pay could not be prepared.
Runs.Title: Pay run
Runs.Missing: This pay run does not exist.
Runs.CloseDescription: The run and its {count} payslips are numbered and can no longer be changed. The advances taken back are written in the ledger.
Runs.DeleteDescription: Its payslips are taken away with what was typed on them. The hours stay.
Runs.VoidDescription: Its payslips no longer count and the month can be prepared again. The wages paid on it must be voided first.
Runs.DraftHint: A draft: check each payslip, then close the month.
Runs.Refreshed: Computed again from the hours as they are now.
Runs.NoPayslip: Nobody has anything to be paid for this month.

Slips.Title: Payslip
Slips.CorrectDescription: What is typed here replaces what the program computes, and stays when the month is computed again. Empty a field to go back to the computed amount.
Slips.DraftPrint: This month is not closed yet: the payslip has no number and may still change.
Slips.Lines: What is paid and what is taken off
Slips.LinesHint: Overtime is paid at the hourly value plus 50%.
Slips.SeatsHint: Each order is paid once. One typed in after its month closed is paid here, as arrears.
Slips.PlannedSeats: {count} paid at planned time, not typed

Ledger.Title: Advances, debts and payments
Ledger.None: No line: nothing was ever owed.

Entry.AdvanceDescription: An advance is taken back on the next payslip, all of it unless the office spreads it.
Entry.WageDescription: Left to pay on this payslip: {left}. A part of it can be paid now and the rest later.
Entry.VoidDescription: The payment stays in the list, struck through. An advance leaves the ledger; a wage is owed again.

Pay.Description: Each worker's hours, the monthly pay, advances and debts.

Items.Title: Monthly allowances and deductions
Items.Hint: Added to, or taken off, every payslip of the months they cover.
Items.Label: What for

Stats.LeaveHint: Earned from 1 July to 30 June, taken the year after

Days.Title: Days
Days.Hint: The hours of a day are counted between each time in and the time out that follows it.

Entry.CheckTitle: Record a time in or out
Entry.LeaveDescription: The rest day is not counted. A leave that runs over two months is cut at the month's end.

EmployeeAttendance.Description: The employees' times in and out, their absences and their leave.

Hiring.Description: Candidates, interviews and decisions, training days, violations and periodic evaluations.

Candidates.None: No candidate and nobody on trial.

Evaluations.DueHint: Every worker is evaluated each period set in Settings, on the seven criteria of article 16.

Skills.Title: Skills
Skills.Hint: The services and machines a worker masters: the centre keeps its own list.
Skills.None: No skill in the list yet.

Entry.OutcomeDescription: The ten points per criterion are typed on the worker's file, in the confidential evaluation.
Entry.DecisionDescription: A trial ends on the day given, or after the days set in Settings.
Entry.ViolationSaved: The violation is recorded: it waits for a decision.
Entry.EvaluationDescription: Each criterion is marked from 1 to the scale set in Settings.

SanctionPending.Title: Waiting for your answer
SanctionPending.Hint: Somebody suspended or penalised is being registered: do we allow them?

TrialEnding.Title: Trials ending
TrialEnding.Hint: A worker's trial ends within {days} days: decide

StaffContractEnding.Title: Contracts ending
StaffContractEnding.Hint: An employee's contract ends within {days} days

ViolationOpen.Title: Violations to decide
ViolationOpen.Hint: Recorded or handed over, with no decision yet
